## Motivation & Research Question 💟

Cardiovascular disease (CVD) develops through a combination of biological, behavioral, and lifestyle factors that accumulate over time. Rather than acting independently, these elements tend to cluster and reinforce one another, influencing overall cardiovascular health.

-   How do demographic factors and health factors impact the probability that an individual will experience a heart attack?
